correctness.rationale: The exact open-neighborhood/vertex-cover equivalence is elementary and holds for every pair vertex; a selected edge is indispensable exactly when deleting it lowers the cover number from three to two. Four ordered 2+2 event supports per edge provide a mutually disjoint probability-1/6 certificate, forcing at most six selected edges. Exhaustive graph augmentation enumerates all simple no-isolate edge graphs through the proven six-edge bound and tests every three-cover-critical class; four survivor types result, with direct checks of their defining property. The labeled automorphism denominators yield 15, 10, 12, 1 copies on supports of sizes 6, 5, 5, 4. Independent exhaustive open-neighborhood checks n=4..8 match every coefficient; they corroborate but do not replace the universal proof.

value.rationale: This is an entire natural all-order inclusion-minimal total-domination spectrum, not merely the already-known minimum. Exact four-type classification and coefficients determine numbers of minimal feasible sets at each cardinality and a sharp upper total domination parameter. The K4 and K3 disjoint K2 configurations are total-minimal but are missed by the traditional minimum-only description. A bounded-edge structural obstruction explains why the spectrum stabilizes at cardinality six for every n.
